# 获取关键词列表

请求接口： [https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/unit/bid_weight/list](https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/unit/bid_weight/list)

请求方式：POST

数据格式：JSON

### 请求参数

|字段|类型|是否必填|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|--|
|advertiser_id|Long|必填|广告主账号ID||
|filter_param|Object|非必填|筛选条件||
|page_info|Object|必填|分页信息||


|filter_param|类型|是否必填|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|--|
|word|String|非必填|关键词（模糊匹配）||
|unit_id|Long|非必填|广告单元ID||

|page_info|类型|是否必填|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|--|
|current_page|Long|必填|当前页||
|page_size|Long|必填|页大小||


### 返回参数

|字段|类型|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|
|code|Integer|返回状态码||
|message|String|返回状态信息||
|data|Object|返回数据内容||

|data|类型|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|
|total_count|Long|优词数量||
|page_size|Long|页大小||
|current_page|Long|当前页||
|list|Object[]|优词信息||

|list|类型|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|
|bid_weight|Double|提量系数|1.1-2区间，最多一位小数|
|word|String|关键词内容||
|scope|Integer|生效范围|1 - 账户为度，2 - 广告组维度|
|unit_info|Object[]|广告组信息|优词的scope = 2的情况下会返回该字段|


|unit_info|类型|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|
|unit_name|String|广告组名称||
|unit_id|Long|广告组id||
|campaign_id|Long|计划id||

### 请求样例

```json
{
  "advertiser_id": 139494,
  "page_info": {
    "current_page": 1,
    "page_size": 10
  },
  "filter_param": {
    "unit_id": 3891211196,
    "word": "快手科技",
  }
}
```

### 返回样例

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "data": {
    "total_count": 2,
    "list": [
      {
        "scope": 2,
        "word": "yiulld02",
        "unit_info": [
          {
            "unit_name": "激励视频-__20240226_11:33_0226_14:30_0226_14:31-1",
            "unit_id": 3891211196,
            "campaign_id": 2004407724
          }
        ],
        "bid_weight": 1.1
      },
      {
        "scope": 2,
        "word": "yiulld01",
        "unit_info": [
          {
            "unit_name": "激励视频-__20240226_11:33_0226_14:30_0226_14:31-1",
            "unit_id": 3891211196,
            "campaign_id": 2004407724
          }
        ],
        "bid_weight": 1.1
      }
    ],
    "current_page": 1,
    "page_size": 10
  },
  "message": "OK",
  "request_id": "EL2BgIDw9pmaChi5DSDM4Yiu4zEo3cHIjA8="
}
```
